title: 第1752章 击败魔族事情不妙第1751章 魔族踪迹
slug: 瞎婿第1754章总算找到你了
content_zh:
轰隆！
伴随着一声惊天动地的巨响，那火焰手掌将双翼恶魔死死的压在了地上，在地面上留下了一道百里痕迹，至于那双翼恶魔，身躯早已被砸的支离破碎，并且烧成了焦炭。
“哼，好厉害的小丫头！”
看到这一幕，为首的黑袍恶魔，不由心生忌惮。
“告诉我，你们是怎么找到这里的，我就留给你一个全尸！”
韩清雪俏脸上，没有半点的表情波动，彷佛是万载不化的寒冰，让人不敢靠近。
“呵呵，小丫头，你们身上有我们魔主留下的印记，所以无论你们跑到何处，我们都可以找到！”
为首的黑袍恶魔怪笑起来。
“原来是这样。”
韩清雪右手再次抬起，神凰圣火在其四周，瞬间凝聚出了九个庞大的炽热火球。
“现在我就送你，去见你的魔主！”
“啧啧，我承认你的实力很强，但是……想要杀我，你还差点意思！”
黑袍恶魔从袖子里探出了一只血色大手，掌心当中，则有一颗黑色珠子。
那黑色珠子缓缓转动，四周的魔气，疯狂汇聚，很快变成了一道足有万丈之高的，魔气风暴。
“小丫头，乖乖受死吧！”
魔气风暴飞速转动，呼啸天地，向着韩清雪冲击而来。
“哼，区区魔族，也敢造次！”
韩清雪深吸一口气，玉手掐动法印，九个炽热无比的庞大火球，宛如九个灼灼烈日，同时向着那黑色风暴轰了过去。
轰隆隆！
九颗庞大的炽热火球和魔气风暴猛烈撞击在了一起，神凰圣火和魔气疯狂抵消。

相比九颗炽热的烈日，那魔气风暴明显更加恐怖。
然而神凰圣火是魔气的克星，因此一番激烈的碰撞之后，那魔气风暴反而被压制。
“怎么会这样，这小丫头的实力这么强？”
那黑袍恶魔吃惊不已，本以为韩清雪只是普通的真仙武者，他可以凭借魔珠将其镇压，可是一番交手之后，他才发现自己完全低估了韩清雪的能量。
“魔族受死！”
韩清雪双手合十，炽热的神凰圣火，疯狂凝聚，在其身后，迅速凝聚成了一只庞大的神凰法相。
神凰法相双翼展开，那九颗炽热的火球，瞬间变大了数倍，魔气风暴直接溃散开来。
“神凰法相，这丫头难怪如此厉害，她竟然是神凰古族的人！”
content_en:
Boom!
With an earth-shattering loud noise, the flaming palm pressed the two-winged demon to the ground, leaving a trace of a hundred miles on the ground. As for the two-winged demon, its body had already been smashed into pieces and burned into coke.
"Humph, what an amazing little girl!"
Seeing this scene, the leader of the black-robed demon couldn't help but feel afraid.
"Tell me how you found this place, and I'll leave you with a whole body!"
There was no expression on Han Qingxue's pretty face, as if it were ice that would never melt, making people afraid to get close.
"Haha, little girl, you have the mark left by our demon lord on your body, so no matter where you go, we can find it!"
The leader of the black-robed demon laughed strangely.
"So that's it."
Han Qingxue raised her right hand again, and the Divine Phoenix Holy Fire instantly condensed nine huge blazing fireballs around it.
"Now I will send you to see your demon master!"
"Tsk, tsk, I admit that you are very strong, but... you are not even willing to kill me!"
The black-robed demon poked out a big bloody hand from his sleeve, and in the palm of his hand was a black bead.
The black bead slowly rotated, and the surrounding demonic energy gathered crazily, quickly turning into a demonic energy storm that was ten thousand feet high.
"Little girl, just accept your death!"
The storm of demonic energy rotated rapidly, roaring to the heaven and earth, and rushed towards Han Qingxue.
"Hmph, even a mere demon clan dares to make a mistake!"
Han Qingxue took a deep breath, pinched the seal with her jade hand, and nine extremely hot and huge fireballs, like nine scorching suns, blasted towards the black storm at the same time.
Boom!
Nine huge blazing fireballs and the demonic energy storm violently collided together, and the Divine Phoenix Holy Fire and the demonic energy were offset wildly.
Compared to the nine blazing scorching suns, the demonic storm was obviously more terrifying.
However, the Divine Phoenix Holy Fire is the nemesis of demonic energy, so after a fierce collision, the demonic energy storm was suppressed.
"How could this happen? This little girl is so strong?"
The black-robed demon was shocked. He thought that Han Qingxue was just an ordinary true immortal warrior and he could suppress it with the magic beads. However, after a fight, he realized that he had completely underestimated Han Qingxue's energy.
"Death to the demons!"
Han Qingxue clasped her hands together, and the blazing divine fire of the divine phoenix condensed crazily. Behind her, it quickly condensed into a huge divine phoenix.
Divine Phoenix Dharma's wings spread out, and the nine blazing fireballs instantly grew several times larger, and the demonic storm immediately dispersed.
"Dharma Master of the Divine Phoenix, no wonder this girl is so powerful, she is actually a member of the ancient Divine Phoenix clan!"
